sec.title: September 3 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 712)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial story metadata declarations, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 3** across three distinct eras of nocturnal storytelling with Jean Shepherd on WOR New York (his 1960 taxi/circus monologues, his 1965 Hammond adolescence reflections, and his 1973 radio log retrospective), small-town sleuth mysteries with Santos Ortega on *The Affairs of Peter Salem*, lively wartime national debates on price controls on *America's Town Meeting of the Air*, and Canadian Northwest Mounted Police cliffhangers, Jean Shepherd (1960, 1965, 1973), Santos Ortega (1950), *America's Town Meeting* (1942), and *Blair of the Mounties* (1935–1973):
